description: Third-party trim analysis warnings that test-aot.ps1 accepts in the published standalone consumer. A warning that names BlazorECharts is never accepted. Explanations: docs/compatibility/wasm-aot.md.

warnings.reason: Static [JSInvokable] lookup by assembly name scans types with Type.GetMethods. BlazorECharts calls back only through DotNetObjectReference instances.
Instance callbacks are found by reflection on the referenced object's runtime type. DotNetObjectReference.Create<T> keeps the public methods of T, which covers every BlazorECharts callback type.
The renderer reflects over component.GetType(). Component types are kept by the DynamicallyAccessedMembers annotation on OpenComponent<TComponent> and the router's component lookup.

warnings.pattern: Field 'Microsoft\.AspNetCore\.Components\.Routing\.Router\.<NotFoundPage>k__BackingField' with 'DynamicallyAccessedMembersAttribute' is accessed via reflection
warnings.reason: OpenComponent<Router> requires all Router members, and Router.NotFoundPage itself carries a DynamicallyAccessedMembers annotation. Any app that renders Router reports it.

warnings.pattern: Method 'Microsoft\.AspNetCore\.Components\.Routing\.Router\.NotFoundPage\.set' with parameters or return value with `DynamicallyAccessedMembersAttribute` is accessed via reflection
warnings.reason: Same cause as the IL2110 entry, reported by the compiler's trim analyzer and by ILLink.
